protocol: PATCH-TRAIN-2 STRESS-CAP-1 registration (DISCOVERY ONLY; thresholds not used; confirmatory entities unopened)
selection_rule: highest address cosine among eligible pairs (different assigned answers); ties by lower index
note_on_independence: the three pairs are the three edges of a triangle on {Brimokvolia, Frosalvolia, Thapylvolia}: they share entities, so they are NOT three independent observations and no rate may be inferred

config.backend: PyTorch CPU f32 eager bs1; frozen v2 emulation f64-seq-rne1/v1
arms: 5 A then B learned on A
6 B then A learned on B

per_pair_recorded: address overlap and cross-response c_AB, c_BA per prompt

classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.learns_in_isolation: the association's training prompt is full-vocabulary top-1 at the final step in its isolated arm (arm 1 for A, arm 2 for B)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.isolated_class: both | only A | only B | neither
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.sequential_rescue: an association that is NOT top-1 in isolation but IS top-1 on its training prompt in arm 5 or arm 6 (reported per arm); 'rescue over composition' additionally requires it to be top-1 in no composition arm (3, 4, 7)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.coexist_after_sequential_learning: both training prompts are top-1 in arm 5 (reported separately for arm 6)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.retention_fails_despite_isolated_success: an association top-1 in isolation whose training prompt is not top-1 in a stack arm (reported per arm 3-7)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.counts: exact counts out of three pairs, with the independence note above; no success rate is inferred

causes_to_report_for_failures: cap-limited (cap binds on most steps and the loss is still falling or high)
interference-limited (partner leakage or cross-response grows in the stack)
